source.read: Git objects at the commit (git show <commit>:<path>), never a working tree

files.ported: TypeScript; the upstream origin (UPSTREAM) and the mirrored prefixes (PREFIXES) are configuration instead of next.facemorph.me and the five runtime/ prefixes; the SITE service binding is optional (global fetch to UPSTREAM otherwise); a fetch that would leave the configured origin is refused; an unconfigured Worker answers 503 and fetches nothing. Status codes and headers are classic's.

Every classic case, run in workerd through Miniflare against its local R2 bucket and a real local HTTP upstream with a fault switch instead of an in-memory bucket and a stub site; plus refused prefixes, upstream-only fetching and the unconfigured Worker.

Not imported here: FaceMorph's deploy values (Worker name, R2 bucket, service binding, custom domain) belong to the app's deploy configuration, which deploy.staging (fm-8tyu) imports; this package's deploy command takes them as arguments and uses the cf CLI, not Wrangler (operator, 24 October 2026).
